# Daily Report — 2026-10-09

## Task Completed
Added `list_request_comments` tool — lists journal entries (comments and work notes)
for sc_request records. Queries `sys_journal_field` scoped to `name=sc_request`.
Accepts REQ number or 32-char sys_id. Optional `entry_type` filter ('comments' or
'work_notes'). Pagination via `has_more` / `next_offset`. Registered in service_desk
and full packages.
